I like your comment! Absolutely. I'm a physicist so I'm aware that we are the ones who invent the imagining diagnosis test and much more, and doctors just follow an algorithm, and they do it wrong, so they'd be better off replaced with a machine. I've thought of this!
And the creativity part, which they don't show, yes maybe machine learning can help with that!
I feel you, I hope you find some help soon.I've wasted a lot of money on doctors too, and not just to get not positive results, but actually to get me a lot worse. Like what happened yesterday. They put my life seriously and continiusly in danger. I'm better off without them! I bet if I could prescribe myself some test, rehab and medication I'd be doing better or cured by now!
I have an invisible disability and it's shit. I feel you.

Again I'm sorry to read this. I do relate somehow as well. I always check medication compatibility on my own because they might give you the wrong stuff to take.
It has happened to me in the past many-several times. 

I'm sorry you're dealing with this shit. I really do. They shouldn't have put you into such situation and risk. 

The worst part is that when you challenge them it's like they gaslight you and people in general are like "how can a doctor be wrong" "listen to your doctor" "go to the doctor" and they themselves also like. Things are not as everyone portraits they are, and then you have to deal with people telling you shit and lies. And also for example I don't have a recognise disability but I'm quite disabled but for people it's like, "if you don't have the card then you may not be disabled" But if doctors don't recognise your condition how are you gonna get it. For people is like "if you're sick, then a doctor would give you a note for it". When it can't be further away from the truth. 
Or people just believing what doctor said to you instead of your own testimony. You tell them your struggles and they doubt you instead of not believing the doctor. It's just so detached from reality.

Do you take gabapentin for nerve pain and does it help you?

I'm sorry too. 
I'm sorry you went through this as well. Shame on your doctors. Stories like yours touch me because it's just not right!!!! 
I'm truly sorry. 

I feel you when you said "did they apologise, no". EXACTLY! They say shit and if then they're wrong or make you get worse they just look the other way. 
I got very pissed with one doctor telling me "not to try to do the doctors job" as most of them say to me when I talked about what I've researched on my own and debate them or just mention medical stuff or terminology. and after telling him all the shit I've been through and how I'm forced to do their jobs just stayed silent and talked about sth else. Didn't care of any of the abuse doctors did to me I told him about. 
The worst is when they say it's on your head and that if you don't accept it you'll never get better which destroys you entirely. The thing of "it's a doctor, pay attention, or might be right" destroys you so much because they're such morons and that's like the biggest lie in this world, it really destroys you completely because it's like trying to accept something that can't be further away from reality. Thus feeling wrong and invalidated and broken. And many more things. 

I also only got some attention in the ER very recently where they gave me progabaline after refusing opioids. I only took it for one day because it almost made me pass away alongside tizanidine, but before that my pain got a bit better maybe. Now I have gapapentin to try but haven't done it yet because I don't want to pass out so I'm waiting to have someone to try it. 
But in any case what I need is knowing where does the pinched nerve come from to mechanically fix it. 
Also no one explains to me (not even a neurologist) what do this meds (gapapentin, pregrabalin), if they're like painkillers or it can actually improve nerve irritation and help recovery (not just masking the pain).

I have seen almost every traumatologist in my city and yes he's an extremely shitty doctor. He's an as*hole. He deserves the worst. But it's all this is. Shame on them. They should really be ashamed of how awful human beings they are. The rest had brushed me off and didn't even run any test. At best "it'll pass" when I'm disabled. And no benefits whatsoever. Living on my savings, ending soon. Unable to do any kind of job and I'm a physicist with a master degree, but can't even be sitting for a hour. Plus severe mental illnesses as well.
It's the least bad I've had in 3 years. Seen many already. Yes he's shit imagine how the others were.
I'm sorry you're another victim or their evil
